primer: Advanced Micro Devices designs EPYC server CPUs, Instinct AI accelerators, Ryzen PC chips, and Xilinx FPGAs. Q3 2026 sales rose 45% YoY to $13.38 billion with Q4 guided to $17.0 billion, yet Pass 1 grades AMD CYCLICAL_CONDITIONAL. Growth carries $81.8 billion in off-balance-sheet obligations, $11.46 billion in inventory, and a Nov 23 Form S-3ASR registering 336.93 million resale shares. At $387.65, AMD sits in a Stage 4 breakdown below its 30-week and 200-day averages, above our $375.00 Base fair value. New capital is REJECTED on Valuation and Trend, holding action is NOT_HELD (0 shares), and 100% of marginal cash stays in USD reserves.
